# THOR subnet (SN112)

> Illustrative only. A simplified example of the basic loop in THOR's Bittensor subnet.
> Some rules differ from the planned design; where they differ, https://thormachines.ai/docs
> describes how SN112 will work. The network is not live, no weights are set and nothing
> here earns rewards yet.

THOR's subnet labels first-person video of people doing hands-on tasks, for robotics
training: it splits each task into steps, marks when each starts and ends, and captions
each step with the action, the object and the hand. V1 uses open-source footage and aims
to publish an open dataset that proves the network can do this well.

- Miners fetch jobs (never pushed), label them by any method, and submit before the
  deadline. Late or malformed work scores zero. See docs/protocol.md.
- Submissions are scored against answer keys on segmentation, timing and captions. See
  docs/scoring.md; the implementation is thor/scoring.py.
- Validators score submissions, fact check with vision language models, and are
  themselves scored on catching broken labels and passing correct ones. See
  docs/validators.md.
- The protocol's documents are JSON Schemas in thor/schemas/ with examples in examples/.
- thor-miner, thor-validator and thor-mock-server run the loop locally.
